description: Security rules for TypeScript files — prevents unsafe type usage, XSS, SQL injection, and secrets

type-safety.description: Rules preventing unsafe TypeScript type usage

rules.description: Avoid explicit any type annotation — use unknown or a concrete type
rules.message: Avoid ': any' — use 'unknown' and narrow the type, or provide a concrete type

rules.description: Avoid casting to any with 'as any'
rules.message: Avoid 'as any' — use a specific type assertion or unknown

injection.description: Rules preventing injection vulnerabilities in TypeScript

rules.message: eval() is a code injection vector — use JSON.parse or a safer alternative

rules.description: No direct innerHTML assignment — XSS risk
rules.message: Direct innerHTML assignment is an XSS vector — use textContent or a sanitizer

rules.description: No raw SQL with template literals — SQL injection risk
rules.message: SQL built with template literals is vulnerable to injection — use parameterized queries

secrets.description: No hardcoded secrets in TypeScript files

rules.description: No hardcoded API keys, tokens, or passwords
rules.message: Hardcoded secret detected — use environment variables or a secrets manager
